sources.entry: OpenSearch - Distributed and RESTful search engine. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Java/Docker/K8S/deb

summary.one_liner: OpenSearch is an open-source, enterprise-grade search and observability suite for large-scale unstructured data.
summary.what_it_does: The README is a short landing page that describes OpenSearch as an open-source search and observability suite for unstructured data at scale. It links out to the project website, downloads, documentation, forums and Slack, plus contributor, maintainer, release, admin and testing guides. It also covers the Code of Conduct, a security reporting process (email rather than public issues), and trademark notes, including that it includes Apache-licensed Elasticsearch code. The README does not list specific features, APIs, or install steps, so the capabilities here come from the listing and the project's own description only.
notable: Distributed, RESTful search engine per the awesome-selfhosted listing
Covers search and observability use cases
Governed under LF Projects, LLC trademark
caveats: README does not include installation or usage instructions; see the external documentation
Includes Elasticsearch-derived code, with trademark notices for ELASTICSEARCH noted in the README
